Use the existing scheduler for the daily export. It already provides the required capabilities, has two identified owners, and the proposed service has no agreed operator. A new service would add an operational responsibility without addressing a demonstrated gap.

Keep export logic separate from scheduling so its behavior remains understandable and maintainable. Confirm that the scheduler’s owners accept responsibility for this job; ownership of the scheduler does not automatically establish ownership of the export.

Reconsider a separate service only if a concrete requirement emerges that the scheduler cannot meet, such as necessary failure isolation or an independent lifecycle. No such requirement is established here.
